title: Blockcassone Token
description: A source NFT placed into a cube slot. This is the onchain artefact that seeds a cube's appearance. Derived from the wallet/contract state — not generated by the renderer.

tokenId.description: Token ID as reported by the contract.

owner.description: Current owner address at time of placement.

isNormie.description: Whether this token is a Normie (true) or external non-normie NFT (false). Determines which rendering path is used for its cube.

slotIndex.description: Which motif (cube) slot this token occupies. Corresponds to plane.hierarchy.motifIndex.

normie.description: Present only when isNormie is true. Normie-specific onchain data.

traitsHash.description: Raw traits hash from the Normie contract. Drives the traits banner and voxel texture.

pixels.description: 40×40 pixel grid (1600 values). Each value is 0 (empty) or 1 (filled). Stored row-major: index = row*40 + col.

category.description: Normie status category. 0=burned, 1=base, 2=edited, 3=awakened, 4=awakened+edited. Determines rendering style overrides.

agentBound.description: Whether an agent binding exists for this normie. True = awakened.
